label: Every intellect that is not INFINITE_1 has a non-maximal power of knowing
paraphrase: Derived conditional premise (its two premises remain open), analyst formulation, attribution deferred. For every x: if x has intellect (HAS_INTELLECT_1) and is not INFINITE_1, some non-maximal degree p bounds x's power of knowing (PowerOfKnowingBoundedBy, definition 431287d4: x knows nothing at a degree above p). The q.12 a.7 premise 'a created intellect's power of knowing is finite', in its weakest form: the bound is only non-maximal, not finite in a quantitative sense. Derived (nonInfiniteIntellectHasNonMaximalPower) from 'Whatever is not INFINITE_1 has a non-maximal degree of act' and 'Nothing knows anything at a degree above its own degree of act', with the knower's degree of act as the bound.
